description_en: Retrieves the plaintext of a secret
description_zh: 查询一个凭据信息，获取凭据明文
kebab_example: aliyun eiam-developerapi obtain-credential --authorization Bearer_xxxxxx --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --credential-identifier credential_identifier_test --region cn-hangzhou
name: ObtainCredential

parameters.help_en:
Authentication information. The format is `Bearer ${access_token}`.

Use an access token issued by IDaaS
parameters.help_zh:
认证信息。 格式为：Bearer ${access_token}。 
请输入IDaaS签发的Access Token
parameters.name: authorization

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IDaaS instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The identifier for the credential to obtain
parameters.name: credential_identifier

createTime.description_en: The creation time of the credential, formatted as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds
createTime.description_zh: 创建时间，Unix 时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

credentialContent.description_en: The detailed content of the credential. The structure of this object depends on the value of `credentialType`

apiKeyContent.description_en: Contains details for an API key credential. Returned only when `credentialType` is `api_key`
apiKeyContent.description_zh: API Key 凭证类型的凭据内容

oauthClientContent.description_en: Contains details for an OAuth client credential. Returned only when `credentialType` is `oauth_client`
oauthClientContent.description_zh: OAuth 客户端认证凭证类型的凭据内容
oauthClientContent.title_zh: OAuth客户端认证凭证类型的凭据内容。

credentialCreationType.description_en:
Indicates how the credential was created. Valid values:

`system_init`: System-initiated.

`user_custom`: User-created
credentialCreationType.description_zh:
凭据的创建类型。取值可选范围：
system_init：系统创建。
user_custom：用户创建

credentialScenarioLabel.description_en:
The usage scenario for the credential. Valid values:

`llm`: For use with a large language model.

`saas`: For use with a third-party SaaS application
credentialScenarioLabel.description_zh:
凭据的使用场景标签。取值可选范围：
llm：大模型。
saas：三方 SaaS 服务

credentialSharingScope.description_en: The sharing scope of the credential, such as whether it is exclusive to a specific account

credentialSubjectId.description_en: The ID of the credential's subject

credentialSubjectType.description_en:
The credential's subject type. Valid values:

`authentication_token_provider`: An authentication token provider
credentialSubjectType.description_zh:
凭据所属的主体类型。取值可选范围：
authentication_token_provider：认证令牌提供商

credentialType.description_en:
The credential type. Valid values:

`api_key`: The credential is an API key.

`oauth_client`: The credential represents an OAuth client
credentialType.description_zh:
凭据类型。取值可选范围：
api_key：API Key认证凭证。
oauth_client：OAuth客户端认证凭证

exclusiveUserId.description_en: The ID of the account that exclusively owns the credential. This field is present only when `credentialSharingScope` is `user_exclusive`

status.description_en:
The status of the credential. Valid values:

`enabled`: The credential can be used.

`disabled`: The credential cannot be used
status.description_zh:
凭据状态。取值可选范围：
enabled：启用。
disabled：禁用

updateTime.description_en: The last update time of the credential, formatted as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds
updateTime.description_zh: 更新时间，Unix 时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
